conclusion: The structural laws of the Six Birds corpus through Foundations IV are stated from the standpoint of an external theorist: the theorist declares a lens, detects an obstruction, installs a repair, prices a residual, and runs the audit. This paper makes the closure apparatus part of the carrier. An endogenous closure system carries its own instruments, ledgers, repair generator, boundary records, and re-audit loop, and its claims of self-repair are admitted only when the relevant records are produced by its own transitions under a closed-loop source policy. Six definitions (D1–D6) and sixteen laws (E1–E16) give the resulting catalog: endogenous repair, bounded reflexivity, self-maintenance, repair compilation and collapse; priced exposure, alarm, control prices, and probe acquisition; stack rewrite, individuation, and repair transport; and reconsolidation, offline reclosure, and adaptability. The laws are carrier-side and substrate-independent. Living, cognitive, and social systems therefore enter on equal terms: physiological regulation and organismal maintenance, agent-side learning and control, and institutional reproduction and rewrite are distinct realizations of the same typed hypotheses, not metaphors for one another. Each law is stated in the six-part normal form inherited from Foundations IV, with an obstruction or falsifier, an exactly-one status partition where applicable, a proof spine, interaction discipline, and explicit nonclaims. D1–D6 and the core E1–E16 laws are represented in the companion Lean 4 development and finite Repair-World/law-specific campaign; two named interpretive corollaries, Alarm Fatigue and Operational Selfhood, remain unformalized and are marked accordingly. The finite campaign contains 348 preregistered comparisons across fifteen law-specific result artifacts, all passing. Existing particle and neural substrate experiments supply life-facing null, drive, maintenance, motif, and intervention evidence under explicit nonclaims, while an unrun planarian-regeneration protocol states a concrete biological promotion target and its falsifiers. No definition of biological life, consciousness, death, welfare, or autonomous evolution is claimed.

Foundations I--III.  They are not six psychological faculties or six
biological mechanisms; they are typed structural moves.
\begin{center}
\small
\begin{tabularx}{0.94\textwidth}{@{}lX@{}}
\toprule
Role & Imported structural reading \\
\midrule
P1 & descent or lower-operator rewrite \\
P2 & representability and support gating \\
P3 & route mismatch, rerouting, or holonomy reconciliation \\
P4 & staging, sectors, refinement, or gluing \\
P5 & packaging, completion, and formed-object support \\

as audit governance rather than being smuggled into the P1--P5 generator.

conclusion: A record rho is carried by a system S under scope C if: rho is a coordinate of the carrier state rather than an analyst annotation; its updates occur in the support of S 's transition kernel; and the accepting source record is generated by S 's trajectory under the declared scope, never by fallback or an off-kernel edit. A carried instrument is an instrument whose visibility, thresholds, and check-rule records all satisfy these conditions.

\paragraph{D1 cases.}
If one input quotient already refines the other, their repair join is
fiber-equivalent to the finer input.  The join of a constant quotient with
\(r\) is \(r\); the join with a discrete quotient is discrete; and on an
empty carrier the universal property holds vacuously.  Presentations with
different or even non-isomorphic codomains are compared only by their fiber
relations.  These cases also fix the order convention: under the
finer-to-coarser order, the operation named \(\vee\) in this corpus is
meet-shaped.  Most importantly, D1 constructs the unrestricted common
refinement; it does \emph{not} prove that this joint access is in an admissible
access class.  The Foundations IV F37 obstruction remains a separate gate.

 \Delta(Q_{\ell}^{\rm compiled},F_{\mathcal C},r)=\varnothing.

conclusion: Failure to prove irreversibility alone does not prove recoverability.
expanded_source_wording_tex:
\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:e5}]
Completeness turns the universal phrase ``no admissible carried move'' into a
finite inventory statement.  If an in-budget linked candidate descends, the
definition supplies a collapse falsifier, and the falsifier theorem shows
collapsed core is false.  If none exists,
collapsed core holds.  Coherent unreachability of both repair generator and
apparatus viability kernel in a supplied
\texttt{IrreversibleCollapseInput} selects irreversible collapse.  The
recoverable branch requires its own \texttt{RecoverableCollapseInput}:
coherent evidence of self-reachability, external-only reachability, or a
nonempty kernel, together with explicit negation of the irreversible input.
Failure to prove irreversibility alone does not prove recoverability.  A fully linked external descent is
classified by the subsidy witness before either collapsed branch only when
the witness's no-internal-rescue condition and priority exclusions hold;
external descent alone is insufficient.  Intact apparatus plus
gated-off operations selects suspension.  A later internal rescue with a new
lineage selects revival.  The evidence-priority definitions make these
branches pairwise disjoint, and occurrence completeness supplies existence
and same-claim status-kind uniqueness.
\end{proof}

source_wording_tex:
\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:e5}]
Completeness turns the universal phrase ``no admissible carried move'' into a
finite inventory statement.  If an in-budget linked candidate descends, the
definition supplies a collapse falsifier, and the falsifier theorem shows
collapsed core is false.  If none exists,
collapsed core holds.  Coherent unreachability of both repair generator and
apparatus viability kernel in a supplied
\texttt{IrreversibleCollapseInput} selects irreversible collapse.  The
recoverable branch requires its own \texttt{RecoverableCollapseInput}:
coherent evidence of self-reachability, external-only reachability, or a
nonempty kernel, together with explicit negation of the irreversible input.
Failure to prove irreversibility alone does not prove recoverability.  A fully linked external descent is
classified by the subsidy witness before either collapsed branch only when
the witness's no-internal-rescue condition and priority exclusions hold;
external descent alone is insufficient.  Intact apparatus plus
gated-off operations selects suspension.  A later internal rescue with a new
lineage selects revival.  The evidence-priority definitions make these
branches pairwise disjoint, and occurrence completeness supplies existence
and same-claim status-kind uniqueness.
\end{proof}

The source catalog records a further consequence that is not part of the E7
Lean module.  Suppose viability-coupled positive excess persists across a
declared horizon, the preemption channel has finite carried capacity, and
the total discharge available to that channel is insufficient for the
credited alarm demand.  Then continued treatment of every occurrence as a
fresh currentization cannot remain a free operation.  The source program
allows three audited outcomes: the preemption channel saturates; the system
performs a carried threshold or constraint-set repair; or excess remains as
a statused pathology.  Threshold raising is lawful only when it is charged
to the carried ledger and the original threshold lineage remains available
to audit.  Otherwise the move is indistinguishable from E8.1 budget
inflation, where the report improves while the original-lineage blind spot
does not.

This corollary connects two already named limits without identifying them.
E2 bounds the depth and footprint of carried audit, while E7.1 concerns the
capacity of the preemption channel that acts on viability-coupled excess.
A general theorem translating the E2 carrier-capacity bound into the E7.1
discharge bound remains open.  The corollary is therefore
\emph{interpretation-grade}: its inputs and three outcomes are the
source-program statement, but no theorem in
\path|Laws.E7Alarm| proves their exhaustive partition.

\paragraph{Exact finite witness.}
The one-dimensional Xi fixture has residual and excess values
$0,1,4,9$ for hazard levels 0--3.  Monitoring budgets 1, 2, and 3 give
detection latencies 2, 1, and 0; budget 0 never currentizes and reaches unsafe
state 5.  In three genuine hazards, preemption selects alarm action A and
survives 3/3, while the old-policy ratio ranks ordinary action O at 1 above A
at $1/2$ and dies 3/3.  Protocol-artifact witnesses at thresholds 0 and 1
are lawfully discounted rather than currentized.  Every counted
currentization carries a changed constraint set and the named witness.  The
lab does not exercise boundary nonclosure or Alarm Fatigue, and the paper
does not claim that it does.

expanded_source_wording_tex:
\label{thm:e9}
For a finite nonempty candidate inventory that is sound and complete for
admissibility, a maximum exists for any supplied rational acquisition
discharge divided by supplied cost.  In the Xi paper-host specialization set
the discharge equal to the conditional trace contraction and require positive
carried costs; the maximizing family then has the form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:curiosity}
 M^*\in\arg\max_M
 \frac{\operatorname{tr}\!\left(
 K_{DM\mid L}K_{MM\mid L}^{\dagger}K_{MD\mid L}
 \right)}{c(M)}
\end{equation}
subject to the carried viability-risk bound.  This existence theorem
constructs a maximizing candidate; a carried policy's selected move is
optimal only when it also supplies the separate argmax certificate.  Under
the Xi saturation
certificate \(M=BL\) and \(K_{DM\mid L}=0\), the candidate has zero strict
discharge and cannot count as novelty.  Allocation and acquisition are two
margins of one access economy and may be compared by their carried marginal
discharge per cost.

source_wording_tex:
\label{thm:e9}
For a finite nonempty candidate inventory that is sound and complete for
admissibility, a maximum exists for any supplied rational acquisition
discharge divided by supplied cost.  In the Xi paper-host specialization set
the discharge equal to the conditional trace contraction and require positive
carried costs; the maximizing family then has the form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:curiosity}
 M^*\in\arg\max_M
 \frac{\tr\!\left(
 K_{DM\mid L}K_{MM\mid L}^{\dagger}K_{MD\mid L}
 \right)}{c(M)}
\end{equation}
subject to the carried viability-risk bound.  This existence theorem
constructs a maximizing candidate; a carried policy's selected move is
optimal only when it also supplies the separate argmax certificate.  Under
the Xi saturation
certificate \(M=BL\) and \(K_{DM\mid L}=0\), the candidate has zero strict
discharge and cannot count as novelty.  Allocation and acquisition are two
margins of one access economy and may be compared by their carried marginal
discharge per cost.

expanded_source_wording_tex:
\paragraph{Layer-specific bridge obligations.}
\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=2.4em]
\item[Living systems.]
A transcriptional, immune, bioelectric, or metabolic package qualifies only
when perturbing that carried package changes the organism's own future
support and strictly discharges the named viability obstruction.  A
biomarker readable by an experimenter supplies only the correlate branch.
This application is structural and empirical-candidate grade; it makes no
consciousness claim.
\item[Cognitive systems.]
A plan, working-memory state, or learned controller must restrict or orient
action before the outcome under matched controls.  Goals additionally
survive route substitution.  These are direct operational instantiations,
conditional on the comparator and inventory certificates.
\item[Social and economic systems.]
A decision rule, policy package, or governance procedure qualifies only
when its carried invocation changes admissible organizational action and
repairs the declared class.  Minutes or labels that merely predict later
behavior remain correlates; externally installed compliance machinery is
scaffolding unless and until its source status changes.
\end{description}

\label{rem:e12-selfhood}
At the cognitive scale, take role, memory, action, and viability as the
declared domains whose future probes must be jointly supported.  The source
program calls a \emph{self} the private common repair ledger \(L_S\) through
which those cross-domain probes jointly descend.  ``Private'' here means
carried by the selected system and available to its own repair interfaces;
it does not mean phenomenally private or inaccessible in principle.  The
object of the claim is the ledger and its factorization property, not an
inner observer.

The specialization turns the Foundations IV F17 common-quotient idea
inward.  F17 compares observations across public viewpoints; E12.1 compares
the system's own role, record, action, and viability interfaces.  When one
versioned ledger supplies the distinctions used by all four interfaces, the
same repair occurrence can be traced across them.  When the ledger is lost
or fragmented, histories may remain equal under an action quotient while
their memory or role futures differ, or equal under a role quotient while
their viability futures differ.  Those are ordinary cross-domain split
pairs, not a metaphysical failure of identity.

The corresponding falsifier is therefore operational.  A selfhood claim
fails if the proposed \(L_S\) is not carried, if one declared domain does not
factor through it, if a cross-domain repair borrows an external or
wrong-lineage record, or if fragmentation is claimed without a literal
split pair between two of the declared future readouts.  Conversely, a
common database identifier is insufficient unless the same carried ledger
actually supports the role, memory, action, and viability probes.  A
perfectly integrated ledger can also fail E12 individuation when its budget,
boundary, or repair apparatus is maintained by another carrier.

This is an interpretation-grade corollary and is not part of
\path|Laws.E12Individuation|.  The current development has no theorem
constructing \(L_S\), no exhaustive inventory of cognitive domains, and no
consciousness consequence.  E12.1 is not used by a later proof.

For a boundary quotient $B_I$, viability sufficiency and coarsestness are
separate:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathsf{ViabilitySufficientBoundary}(I,B_I)\iff{}&
\mathsf{SufficiencyClosureCertified}(I,B_I)\\
&{}\land
\forall\pi\in\mathcal Q_{\rm sufficient}\ \exists f,\quad
B_I=f\circ\pi.
\end{aligned}
\]
The direction matters.  Every sufficient quotient $\pi$ may retain extra
distinctions; the boundary keeps no distinction not forced by the declared
viability futures.  Self-maintenance then reuses an actual E3
reinstatement:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\exists t,A_t,A_{t+1},m,R,\quad
&\mathsf{BoundaryApparatus}(I,B_I,A_t)\\
&{}\land\mathsf{MaintenanceReinstatementFor}
  (t,A_t,A_{t+1},m,R)\\
&{}\land I(R.\mathsf{sourceState}).
\end{aligned}
\]
Merely locating a membrane, API, or legal perimeter does not prove this
clause.

conclusion: Four related positive evidence forms hold. Communication evidence requires s to induce a paid, interface-mediated, role-preserving carried receiver repair with strict same-class delta reduction. Teaching evidence adds repairs sourced from B 's own committed state in an A -absent capacity test. Coercion null is certified when the interaction is fully forced, the complete free-response census is empty, no B -committed transported repair exists, and the before/after obstruction is unchanged. Force and census emptiness alone do not derive the latter two facts. Symbolic-repair evidence requires the token to reactivate a carried, role-preserving, saturation-strict R across a declared family whose context list has at least two entries. The formal family has no no-duplicate field, so distinct contexts are not certified. Under the complete priority classifier, the corresponding status also negates every higher raw evidence predicate: communicated excludes coercion-null, symbolic, and taught evidence; taught excludes coercion-null and symbolic evidence; symbolic excludes coercion-null evidence. The four named Lean theorems package supplied full cases; they do not derive status from the positive structure alone.
expanded_source_wording_tex:
\label{thm:e13}
Four related positive evidence forms hold.
\begin{enumerate}
  \item Communication evidence requires \(s\) to induce a
  paid, interface-mediated, role-preserving carried receiver repair with
  strict same-class delta reduction.
  \item Teaching evidence adds repairs sourced from \(B\)'s own committed
  state in an \(A\)-absent capacity test.
  \item Coercion null is certified when the interaction is fully forced, the
  complete free-response census is empty, no \(B\)-committed transported
  repair exists, and the before/after obstruction is unchanged.  Force and
  census emptiness alone do not derive the latter two facts.
  \item Symbolic-repair evidence requires the token to reactivate a
  carried, role-preserving, saturation-strict \(R\) across a declared family
  whose context list has at least two entries.  The formal family has no
  no-duplicate field, so distinct contexts are not certified.
\end{enumerate}
Under the complete priority classifier, the corresponding status also
negates every higher raw evidence predicate: communicated excludes
coercion-null, symbolic, and taught evidence; taught excludes coercion-null
and symbolic evidence; symbolic excludes coercion-null evidence.  The four
named Lean theorems package supplied full cases; they do not derive status
from the positive structure alone.

conclusion: An E-system exhibits coherent adaptability exactly when the two routes are currently indistinguishable but leave a claim-linked difference in held-out repair-capacity distributions that survives all declared controls and is not already an outstanding E15 residue. Such a record has two consequences: the endpoints satisfy the exact CurrentEventEquiv relation; and the exact claim-linked records report unequal future repair probabilities despite matched current endpoints. conclusion: It is the finite-inventory limitation that prevents the paper from claiming robustness against every latent variable.
expanded_source_wording_tex:
One negative governance result is especially important.  An undeclared
proxy cannot be detected by a classifier whose complete universe does not
contain it; the mechanical fixture can retain coherent status until the
proxy is declared and the support controls are rerun.  This is not evidence
that the proxy is harmless.  It is the finite-inventory limitation that
prevents the paper from claiming robustness against every latent variable.
The nine discipline checks record actual-scope, no-hardcoding,
off-inventory-dissipation, predictive-reveal, administrative-rejection,
wrong-claim-E15, same-ID content mutation, same-ID perturbation mutation, and
pair-local flatness isolation.

The catalog is intentionally incomplete.  The following candidates have
recognizable shapes but do not yet possess a distinct theorem, obstruction
set, and recognition interface.

\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Global or conscious access.} Simultaneous descent into
  memory, action, and report may combine E6, E7, E12, and E13 without adding
  a new law.  Phenomenality is outside the present apparatus.
  \item \textbf{Play or sandboxed obstruction sampling.} This currently
  appears to be E9 under a gated risk budget unless transfer from sandbox to
  live repair supplies a new obstruction.
  \item \textbf{Boundary discovery dynamics.} E12 classifies a candidate
  boundary; it does not state how a carrier searches the boundary lattice.
  \item \textbf{Transported gates and norms.} E13 transports repair.  A
  separate P2-transport theorem may be needed for norms, standards, and
  regulatory gates.
  \item \textbf{Distributed exposure and price discovery.} A multi-carrier
  E6/E9 system may model markets or collective sensing, but standard
  aggregation results must not be merely renamed.
  \item \textbf{Reproduction, heredity, and evolutionary closure.} The
  E-series treats repair and adaptation of a declared carrier.  Replication,
  heritable variation, population selection, ecological inheritance, and
  open-ended lineage innovation require additional carrier and source
  machinery.  The life-focused substrate paper likewise separates bounded
  competencies from autonomous open-ended evolution
  \citep{Tsiokos2026Life}.
  \item \textbf{Abiogenesis and origin-of-life transitions.} No theorem here
  selects the first E-system from nonliving chemistry or proves that the
  D1--D6 package is necessary and sufficient for life.
\end{itemize}
